name: VOIP_CALL
description: This table contains information associated with Unified Communications VoIP Calls.

columns.name: VIDEO_VISIT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the VoIP call record.

columns.name: CALL_DATE
columns.description: This virtual item returns the date of the interaction. The returned date is handled differently depending on the contact type of the encounter. If there is no encounter associated with the interaction, then the interaction record creation date (I LVV 90090) is returned. If there is an encounter associated and it is not an admission, then the encounter contact date (I EPT 30) is returned. If there is an encounter associated and it is an admission, then the date of the first connect action logged in (SI LVV 100) is returned. If there is no first connect action, then the interaction record creation date is returned.

columns.name: END_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The end instant of the VoIP call in UTC.

columns.name: CALL_END_REASON_C_NAME
columns.description: The end reason of the VoIP call. This is intended to capture why call workflows ended earlier, before reaching the Nebula service.

columns.name: END_DTTM
columns.description: The end instant of the VoIP call in local time.

columns.name: START_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The start instant of the VoIP call in UTC.

columns.name: START_DTTM
columns.description: The start instant of the VoIP call in local time.

columns.name: PAT_ID
columns.description: The patient associated with the VoIP call.

columns.name: PAT_ENC_CSN_ID
columns.description: The patient encounter associated with the VoIP call.
